evaluation_question: Are execution budgets enforced under concurrency?
Does interrupted local work converge to a valid terminal state?
Are same-origin authorizations paced across local jobs?
Are robots rules and crawl delays applied before requests?
Do scoped templates prevent cross-scope contamination while retaining coverage?
Are fallback ambiguity and repair outcomes observable?
Do independently generated local dataset versions retain semantic equality?
Does interruption-safe publication avoid partial committed versions?
